//comment1: This is the whole configuration of the GeoGirafe Viewer.
//comment2: Here, you can set the entries according to your environment.

general.//comment1: Will be used when formating numbers or dates

languages.//comment1: List of languages with their corresponding translation-file.

themes.//comment2: Name of the default theme. It will be automatically loaded when the application starts

basemaps.//comment1: Display the Basemap control or not
basemaps.//comment3: special basemaps that can be activated or not

search.//comment1: Link to the GeoMapFish-Compliant Search Service
search.//comment2: The muster <###SEARCHTERM###> will be replaced by the search-term

print.//comment1: Link to the GeoMapFish-Compliant Print Service
print.//comment2: The print layout selected by default

projections.//comment1: List of projections with their corresponding abbreviation
